paragraphs: The Defender D350 is part of the modern L663 generation, launched in 2019. It uses the Ingenium AJ300D — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel mild-hybrid. It's the highest-output diesel in the Defender range, positioned above the D250 and D300. The AJ300D is a genuine six-cylinder unit (not a 4-cylinder derivative), and it sits on a different price tier from the 4-cylinder Defender diesel variants.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ300D engines for every Defender D350 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six diesel MHEV fitted to the Defender D350 from 2019 to present (L663 generation). Known for the DC-DC converter failure pattern affecting the entire 12V electrical system on mild-hybrid variants, plus the broader Ingenium timing chain pattern. Early production (2019-2020) also shows electrical injector faults. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, bearings, gaskets and the DC-DC converter as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.
